messages:
Ana M: Heads up 00: We had a convo with FinServ pilot re: evidence export formats and legal-hold semantics. They want an auditable bundle that can be handed to auditors and includes integrity proofs.
Ben T: What formats are they asking? WARC? JSONL? tar.gz + signatures?
Clara R: They prefer a single signed bundle (tar.gz) with a manifest.json listing objects + SHA256. Also want raw request/response + typed events.
Devon S: Ops note: making signed bundles possible is straightforward. Harder part is supporting BYOK customers where we don't hold plaintext keys.
Ana M: Right. Ask from customer: if we can't decrypt for BYOK, can we still provide searchable exports? They want a way to run a search against encrypted data.
Legal-Jane: For SOC2 and ISO audits we need chain-of-custody and proof of non-tampering. If a customer supplies keys, they can request us to produce the archive signed by them or co-signed. We need contract language for key escrow refusal cases.
Ben T: Technical options: 1) ship encrypted blobs + manifest of metadata (timestamps, hashes, sender ids), 2) run an on-prem export job in customer's VPC with keys, 3) provide a helper that runs client-side decryption when they download.
Clara R: Option 2 is preferred for BYOK heavy customers. We can offer an on-demand export runner that executes inside customer environment and writes signed bundles to their object store.
Devon S: Implementation sketch: export job reads events, writes files to /tmp/export/<tenant>/, generates manifest, signs with supplied key (or our fallback KMS), uploads to S3, triggers webhook. Simple pneumatic flow.
OpsBot: Deploy note: export runners must be isolated per-tenant and rate-limited. Also record audit_event:export.started/completed in telemetry.
Ana M: Acceptance criteria for this feature: 1) Manifest spec published; 2) Signed bundle produced for non-BYOK tenants; 3) On-prem runner for BYOK available as beta; 4) Retrieval SLA (48h for standard exports, 8h for expedited paid).
Ben T: We should also support incremental exports for long retention windows (90+ days). A full 90d export can be huge; need chunking and resumable uploads.
Clara R: Chunking + index file with byte ranges. Also include a minimal query index (metadata index) inside bundle to speed lookups for auditors.
Devon S: Security: HSM signing for our side. For co-signing with customer key, we need to accept public keys and support signature verification process.
Legal-Jane: Add to contract templates: export delivery method, signature ownership, liability for keys, and retention of exported copies. Also legal hold override flag and its authorized roles.
Ana M: UX: admin panel to request export, choose timeframe, choose bundle type (signed, co-signed, encrypted), select expedited, and attach PO or justification. Include cost estimate before confirm.
Ben T: Pricing thought: base fee + per-GB charge + expedited surcharge. Also minimum on-call coordination fee for legally compelled requests.
Clara R: Edge-case: subpoenas require immediate preservation (legal hold). We need a toggle that prevents deletion even if retention expired and surfaces to oncall.
Devon S: We'll implement a "preserve until" timestamp on objects and a protected flag. Deletion flows must check preserves. Also add an immutable marker in the manifest.
OpsBot: Caveat: preserve flags must replicate cross-region otherwise failover could drop preserved objects. Add replication check to runbook.
Ana M: Roadmap timing: PoC (2 sprints) for unsigned bundles + manifest; sprint 3 add HSM signing and manifest verification; sprint 4 pilot on-prem runner for BYOK.
Ben T: Risks: BYOK testing matrix huge (different KMS/HSM vendors). Build a reference runner with AWS KMS + Vault for starters.
Clara R: QA: include verification tool that takes bundle and verifies all checksums and signatures. Provide auditors with small README on how to verify.
Legal-Jane: Also note data sovereignty: if bundle contains EU data, delivery must follow export controls. Flag in manifest country_of_origin per record.
Ana M: Action items: Ben -> spec manifest v1 (due Mon), Devon -> spike on runner + cost estimate (due Wed), Legal-Jane -> contract clause draft (due Fri), Clara -> UX mock + cost calc (due Tue).
Devon S: I'll also prototype resumable upload and include sample commands: 
```
exporter --tenant=acme --from=2025-01-01 --to=2025-02-01 --out=acme-feb.tar.gz
```
(we'll add auth and key options)
Ana M: Great. We'll add story to roadmap and pick pilot customer with BYOK need. End thread. :white_check_mark:
